title: Tasting Plant Forward Meals
official: Investigating the Role of Potatoes in Boosting Vegetable Enjoyment and Consumption Among Adolescents and Emerging Adults
summary: This study aims to examine how the amount of potato and form of potato within a meal impacts intake and acceptability of other non-starchy vegetables.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* between the ages of 18-25 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* unable to complete all study procedures
* food allergies to any of the study food
